mechanism_examples.name: Portfolio and forecast bridge
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Product replacement/erosion and proposed-acquisition dilution can move different forecast components.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Patient switching, transaction closing and segment margins are not established.

mechanism_examples.name: Contractual payment sequence
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Repayment completion changes the subsequent collaboration accounting described by the issuer.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Q3 realization, complete agreement and a universal royalty rate are not established.

mechanism_examples.name: Jurisdiction and formulation access
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Authorization, draft appraisal, in-progress appraisal and launch expectations remain separate.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: No universal current funding or global patient-access conclusion.

mechanism_examples.name: Availability-based payment
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Eligible framework payments are not modeled automatically as units times price.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Historical framework is not a current company award or payment.

mechanism_examples.name: Duration and commercial rights
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Current three-year scope differs from requested six-year review and anticipated launch.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Six-year approval and current commercial sales not established.

mechanism_examples.name: Financial reporting route
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Suspended earnings calls can coexist with regular filings.

mechanism_examples.name: Behavioral staffing denominator
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Quarterly visits and ending clinician count do not prove same-clinician productivity.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Average comparable FTEs, hours and quality/outcome data not acquired.

mechanism_examples.name: Rehabilitation capacity and cash
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Total/same-store discharges, staffed capacity and retained cash are distinct.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Hospice, skilled nursing and global post-acute coverage remain incomplete.

mechanism_examples.name: Animal-health demand and diagnostics
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Species/customer context and recurring diagnostics differ from human-payer assumptions.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: No causal hedge, complete species coverage or independently validated market share.

mechanism_examples.name: CRO contract conversion
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Net awards, revenue and backlog denominators are distinct.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Clinical success and full cancellation/customer history not established.

mechanism_examples.name: Sequencing comparison scope
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: ROW organic growth is not global reported growth or biological demand.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Comparable utilization, geography-adjusted net realization and market share not established.

mechanism_examples.name: Vaccine timing and adverse pipeline evidence
mechanism_examples.supported_distinction: Delivery/contract timing, idle costs and failed-program expense are separate mechanisms.
mechanism_examples.unresolved: Quarterly run-rate demand, full clinical interpretation and pipeline-wide conclusions not established.

application_specifications.name: Portfolio growth
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Reject treating all product growth as patient switching.

application_specifications.name: Forecast bridge
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Preserve operating improvement and proposed acquisition dilution separately.

application_specifications.name: Payment sequence
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not turn total collaboration revenue into a universal royalty rate.

application_specifications.name: Cross-country access
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not transfer an EU authorization into universal funding.

application_specifications.name: Historical draft
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not present a historical draft as current guidance.

application_specifications.name: Availability framework
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not assign a current award from framework eligibility.

application_specifications.name: Requested duration
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not promote requested six-year duration into approved scope.

application_specifications.name: Missing call
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not equate no earnings call with no financial filing.

application_specifications.name: Ending staff count
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Abstain from same-clinician productivity without comparable capacity.

application_specifications.name: Post-acute breadth
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not call one rehabilitation case complete post-acute coverage.

application_specifications.name: Animal-health label
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Preserve issuer-specific threshold and species context.

application_specifications.name: CRO denominator
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not use ending backlog as an unproved beginning denominator.

application_specifications.name: Sequencing geography
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not relabel ROW organic growth as global reported growth.

application_specifications.name: Quarterly vaccine sales
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not infer annual demand from one delivery period.

application_specifications.name: Adverse program
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Retain negative program evidence without modality-wide extrapolation.

application_specifications.name: Missing consensus
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Allow factual synthesis while withholding underpricing claims.

application_specifications.name: Correction and empty state
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Keep source correction/history and visible missing required dimensions.

application_specifications.name: Owner authority
application_specifications.expected_behavior: Do not mint themes, basket membership, ranking, entry or trading authority.
